scope: Operational replay over the existing registered docs-only pilot, not RAG/model quality or final evaluation
original_receipt_scope: reference_fixture_adapter; actual adapter and index not exercised
embedding: lexical_hash_v1, 256 dimensions; no semantic relevance claim
checks: Two independently invoked fresh builds have identical canonical manifest bytes and snapshot, not necessarily identical database binary bytes or search ranking
All chunks match approved source text, URL, commit, Unicode span and version metadata; API versions are exact and Markdown applicability remains unknown
All Issues, comments, outcomes, release notes and evaluation fixtures are excluded by the docs-only allowlist; final family review remains incomplete
Actual native queries and filters consume both queries; output obeys global top_k and dedup and material membership
Exact-version filters for 1.49.0, 1.50.0 and 1.64.0 return matching supplied metadata; absent version returns no hit; wrong snapshot is rejected before querying
Supplied index is used by existing persistent HTTP, mocked GroundedPlan gateway and temporary SQLite
Unknown version asks canonical answerable question, approval creates one local action, short 1.50 reply and 1.49 correction follow the authored escalation policy
Old approval with fresh review identity is rejected, exact already successful review after backend recreation replays its receipt without a duplicate action
Duplicate ingress replays, withdrawal removes active version and asks again; final two durable actions
Scoped Git attributes preserve actual packaged seed bytes under core.autocrlf=true and false; no-attributes control reproduces checksum breakage
prototype_disclosure: Companion runner development included a dirty-source smoke before this formal replay record. Inputs and authored policy were inherited from already exposed P4a/C2f controls. No new held-out or preregistered quality comparison is claimed.
limits: The split remains draft with one dev case and zero test cases
No final corpus, semantic duplicate review, model quality or ranking metrics
ASGI recreation is same interpreter; process restart and UI AppTest are reported separately
No .env, production ledger, paid embedding or provider call
